Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِيْ عِلْمٌ بِمَوْضِعِ رِزْقِيْ
Translation: O Allah, I have no knowledge of where my sustenance is

Arabic text: وَإِنَّمَا أَطْلُبُهُ بِخَطَرَاتٍ تَخْطُرُ عَلٰى قَلْبِيْ
Translation: I only seek it through thoughts that occur in my heart
So I wander through different lands in search of it
And in what I am seeking, I am like one who is confused

Arabic text: لَاأَدْرِيْ أَفِيْ سَهْلٍ هُوَ أَمْ فِيْ جَبَلٍ
Translation: I do not know whether it is in a plain or on a mountain

Arabic text: أَمْ فِيْ أَرْضٍ أَمْ فِيْ سَمَاءٍ
Translation: Or in the earth or in the sky

Arabic text: أَمْ فِيْ بَرٍّ أَمْ فِيْ بَحْرٍ
Translation: Or on land or in the sea
And by whose hands
And from whose direction
And I know that its knowledge is with You
And its means are in Your hands
And You are the One who distributes it with Your kindness
And facilitates it with Your mercy

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ يَا رَبِّ رِزْقَكَ لِيْ وَاسِعًا
Translation: And make, O Lord, Your sustenance for me abundant
And its seeking easy
And its attainment near

Arabic text: وَلَا تُعَنِّنِيْ بِطَلبِ مَا لَمْ تُقَدِّرْ لِيْ فِيهِ رِزْقًا
Translation: And do not make me suffer in seeking what You have not destined for me as sustenance
For You have no need to punish me
And I am in need of Your mercy
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And be generous to Your servant with Your grace
Indeed You are the Possessor of great bounty
